sql.query: SELECT p.id FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='commercial.manage' AND p.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=utr.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_tenant_modules tm ON tm.tenantId=utr.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='COMMERCIAL_DETAILS' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 AND (tm.status='ACTIVE' OR (tm.status='TRIAL' AND (tm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR tm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))) LIMIT 1

sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_workflow_commercial_details (tenantId,workflowId,onSaleDateTime,currencyCode,capacity,salesTarget,taxNotes,notes,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,:workflowId,NULLIF(:onSaleDateTime,''),UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(:currencyCode),''),'GBP')),:capacity,:salesTarget,NULLIF(TRIM(:taxNotes),''),NULLIF(TRIM(:notes),''),:userId,:modifiedUserId FROM tbl_workflows w WHERE w.id=:workflowCheck AND w.tenantId=:workflowTenant AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='COMMERCIAL_DETAILS' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=:moduleTenant AND (tm.status='ACTIVE' OR (tm.status='TRIAL' AND (tm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR tm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='commercial.manage' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:permissionUser AND utr.tenantId=:permissionTenant AND utr.isActive=1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE onSaleDateTime=VALUES(onSaleDateTime),currencyCode=VALUES(currencyCode),capacity=VALUES(capacity),salesTarget=VALUES(salesTarget),taxNotes=VALUES(taxNotes),notes=VALUES(notes),modifiedByUserId=VALUES(modifiedByUserId),modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO tbl_workflow_price_entries (tenantId,workflowId,priceLabel,calculationType,amount,eligibility,displayOrder,isActive,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,:workflowId,COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(:priceLabel),''),'Standard price'),:calculationType,CASE WHEN :calculationType2 IN ('free','informational') THEN NULL ELSE :amount END,NULLIF(TRIM(:eligibility),''),100,1,:userId,:modifiedUserId FROM tbl_workflows w WHERE w.id=:workflowCheck AND w.tenantId=:workflowTenant AND :calculationType3 IN ('fixed_amount','percentage_discount','fixed_discount','free','informational') AND (NULLIF(TRIM(:priceLabel2),'') IS NOT NULL OR :amount2 IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(:eligibility2),'') IS NOT NULL OR :calculationType4 IN ('free','informational')) AND (:calculationType5 IN ('free','informational') OR :amount3 IS NOT NULL)
SELECT id FROM tbl_workflow_commercial_details WHERE tenantId=:tenantId AND workflowId=:workflowId LIMIT 1
